cli.input: --input selects the event timeline only; default /app/data/event_timeline.json

description: Output contract for the incident-correlation engine. Shapes, paths, field lists and sort orders only; no derivation rule lives here.

field_shapes.actions: the DISTINCT actions the chain's events carry, ascending -- an action two events share is listed once, not once per event
field_shapes.hosts: the chain's hosts in the order they were first seen, each once

incident_chains.serialisation: JSON array, two-space indent, trailing newline
incident_chains.sort: descending by severity, then ascending by first_ts, then chain_id; hosts in first-seen order; actions ascending, each action appearing once

summary.field_completeness: the object carries exactly the fields listed above and no others -- an extra field is a contract violation, not an addition
summary.field_derivations: this contract fixes the shape only. What each counter means is settled in the shift log: #IR-5194 for truncated_chain_count, #IR-5190 for chain_candidate_count, #IR-5188 for max_severity and the reported set
summary.serialisation: JSON object, two-space indent, trailing newline

triage_queue.serialisation: one compact JSON object per line, trailing newline
triage_queue.sort: descending by severity, then ascending by chain_id then host

event_timeline.serialisation: JSON array, two-space indent, trailing newline

sensor_registry.note: applied during the timeline recovery, not re-read at correlation time

units.severity: integer points fixed per action by the response board
units.timestamps: integer seconds on the reference clock
